claims.claim_text: Total members reached over 13.6 million as of December 31, 2025, a 35% year-over-year increase, while total products reached nearly 20.2 million (+37%).
test_strategy: edgar_fts.query_fulltext for distinctive product name 'SoFi Plus' (no cik) as light external-validation proxy
Note: consumer-member counts have no clean registry analog; expect UNVERIFIABLE per cohort calibration

claims.claim_text: Annualized net charge-off rates on personal loans in Q4 2025 were 2.80%, remaining below the assumed weighted-average default rate in fair-value model of 4.46%; student-loan net charge-off Q4 2025 was 0.76% (above assumed 0.68% due to repurchased seasoned loans).
test_strategy: edgar_fts.query_fulltext for 'SoFi' restricted to ABS-15G or 424B issuers (no direct method, but external mention in securitization-trust filings serves as cross-check)
Internal consistency: framework cannot independently verify charge-off rates without consumer-credit registry; per Calibration note, score UNVERIFIABLE if zero verifiable M-dimensions

claims.claim_text: Total deposits grew to $37.5 billion as of December 31, 2025 (+44% YoY), with members receiving expanded FDIC insurance coverage through a network of participating banks in the Insured Deposit Program.
